messages.subject: Bracken v Calderwood - Advice on merits and quantum (PRIVILEGED & CONFIDENTIAL)
messages.plaintextBody:
Richard,

Privileged and confidential. Please find attached Catherine Rosenthal KC's advice on merits and quantum. In short she puts liability at around 75% in our favour, with the oral variation being their main (and weak) defence. On quantum she values a realistic, risk-weighted recovery at £3.0m-£3.4m before interest, with the loss-of-profit head needing expert accountancy support.

Her recommendation is to prosecute robustly but stay open to mediation, and not to settle materially below £2.8m plus costs. Happy to discuss.

Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
